annotations.phase_0_facts: container.*, headers.fields, part.tree, part.regions, part.gaps, body.preamble_epilogue, decode.chain and body.content_sha256 are what the skeleton walker measures today
annotations.labels_are_typed: every value was read out of the fixture bytes (offsets and lengths) and typed by a model from the RFC and format rules and the design, never copied out of the walker; labels_provenance is spec because a model wrote them, not a person
annotations.span_conventions: a field's raw_span covers its line including the line ending; value_span starts immediately after the colon and keeps the leading space; a part's headers_span includes its closing empty line; the CRLF in front of a boundary line belongs to the delimiter region (RFC 2046), so the regions tile the message exactly
